description.value: Free-floating photosynthetic sheets that complete an entire life cycle in the cloud decks of a giant, rising by day, sinking to the ammonia layer to shed spore at night, and never encountering a surface. Individual sheets have been tracked for eleven years and one has been tracked for twenty-six. Descent to the mat layer has been authorised four times and flown twice, which is the ratio the sampling programme has learned to plan around.
